# Processes and threads

Exiting, threads, waiting and loading libraries.

<h2 id="exit-process"><code>ExitProcess</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func ExitProcess(exitCode: uint32)
```

Ends the calling process and all its threads.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-exitprocess](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-exitprocess)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L103)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type     | Description          |
| ---------- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `exitCode` | `uint32` | the status to report |

<h2 id="free-library"><code>FreeLibrary</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func FreeLibrary(libModule: *opaque) -> bool32
```

Frees the loaded dynamic-link library (DLL) module and, if necessary, decrements its reference count.
When the reference count reaches zero, the module is unloaded from the address space of the calling process
and the handle is no longer valid

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-freelibrary](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-freelibrary)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L145)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type      | Description                                                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `libModule` | `*opaque` | a module handle from [`LoadLibraryA`](/docs/api/windows/process#load-library-a) |

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="get-proc-address"><code>GetProcAddress</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func GetProcAddress(
    libModule: *opaque,
    procName: *char8

```

Retrieves the address of an exported symbol.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-getprocaddress](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-getprocaddress)

| Name        | Type      | Description                                                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `libModule` | `*opaque` | a module handle from [`LoadLibraryA`](/docs/api/windows/process#load-library-a) |
| `procName`  | `*char8`  | the exported symbol's name                                                      |

**Returns**: the symbol's address, or null

<h2 id="load-library-a"><code>LoadLibraryA</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func LoadLibraryA(libFileName: *char8) -> *opaque
```

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-loadlibrarya](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-loadlibrarya)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type     | Description                |
| ------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `libFileName` | `*char8` | the library's name or path |

**Returns**: the module's handle, or null

<h2 id="create-thread"><code>CreateThread</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func CreateThread(
    securityAttributes: *opaque,
    stackSize: uint64,
    startAddress: *opaque,
    parameter: *opaque,
    creationFlags: uint32,
    threadId: *uint32
) -> *opaque
```

Creates a thread to execute within the virtual address space of the calling process.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createthread](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createthread)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L436)

**Parameters**

| Name                 | Type      | Description                                     |
| -------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `securityAttributes` | `*opaque` | a security descriptor, or null for the default  |
| `stackSize`          | `uint64`  | the initial stack size, or zero for the default |
| `startAddress`       | `*opaque` | the thread's entry point                        |
| `parameter`          | `*opaque` | the value handed to the entry point             |
| `creationFlags`      | `uint32`  | the thread creation flags                       |
| `threadId`           | `*uint32` | receives the new thread's identifier, or null   |

**Returns**: the new thread's handle, or null

<h2 id="sleep"><code>Sleep</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func Sleep(milliseconds: uint32)
```

Suspends the execution of the current thread until the time-out interval elapses.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-sleep](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-sleep)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L455)

**Parameters**

| Name           | Type     | Description                |
| -------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `milliseconds` | `uint32` | a duration in milliseconds |

<h2 id="switch-to-thread"><code>SwitchToThread</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func SwitchToThread() -> bool32
```

Causes the calling thread to yield execution to another thread that is ready to run.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-switchtothread](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-switchtothread)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L461)

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="wait-for-single-object"><code>WaitForSingleObject</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func WaitForSingleObject(
    handle: *opaque,
    milliseconds: uint32
) -> uint32
```

Waits until the specified object is in the signaled state or the time-out interval elapses.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-waitforsingleobject](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/synchapi/nf-synchapi-waitforsingleobject)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/Kernel.rux#L469)

**Parameters**

| Name           | Type      | Description                |
| -------------- | --------- | -------------------------- |
| `handle`       | `*opaque` | the handle to act on       |
| `milliseconds` | `uint32`  | a duration in milliseconds |

**Returns**: why the wait ended
